backend.dockerfile:
FROM python@sha256:5e2bdb1b0d542d5039cffb8181c65930093949194a65c365dfb1b0fe13a4fa5b AS wheels

WORKDIR /build
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip wheel --no-cache-dir --wheel-dir /wheels -r requirements.txt

FROM python@sha256:5e2bdb1b0d542d5039cffb8181c65930093949194a65c365dfb1b0fe13a4fa5b

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=wheels,source=/wheels,target=/wheels \
    pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=/wheels -r requirements.txt

COPY app ./app

# R-7：非 root 运行；/app 与 /data 归 appuser 所有
RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser -d /app appuser \
    && mkdir -p /data && chown -R appuser:appuser /app /data

EXPOSE 8000

USER appuser

# SQLite 下保持单 worker，避免写锁冲突
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--workers", "1"]

frontend.dockerfile:
# build stage
FROM node@sha256:fb4cd12c85ee03686f6af5362a0b0d56d50c58a04632e6c0fb8363f609372293 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# production stage：R-7 非 root nginx（监听 8080，不用 root 占 80 端口）
FROM nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged@sha256:65e3e85dbaed8ba248841d9d58a899b6197106c23cb0ff1a132b7bfe0547e4c0
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
